name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: Software that lets a huge AI model run on an ordinary gaming PC by cleverly loading only the parts of the model it needs from disk, instead of requiring a data-center's worth of memory.
buyer: A well-equipped AI hobbyist or researcher with a high-end gaming PC (lots of RAM/VRAM) who wants to run massive AI models privately without renting expensive cloud GPUs.
business_use_cases: A privacy-focused startup runs a huge open-weight model entirely on owned hardware to avoid sending sensitive data to a cloud API.
A university research lab runs frontier-scale models on existing lab workstations instead of requesting a costly GPU cluster budget.
A hardware reviewer or YouTuber benchmarks consumer PCs against this tool to demonstrate 'how big a model can your rig run,' driving hardware sales/affiliate revenue.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid consulting to help companies configure multi-tier VRAM/RAM/disk setups for their specific hardware and model choice.

steal_this: This is deep systems engineering, not a weekend clone — the realistic weekend project is a benchmarking/leaderboard site that ranks consumer PCs by what models they can run with it, monetized via hardware affiliate links.
